row: Herts Horses Hydrotherapy and Physiotherapy Centre

Hi Everyone!

Welcome to Herts Horses Hydro and Physio channel! We will be sharing all our tip, tricks and advise to help your horses and/or dogs from various prospectives, from home physiotherapy demos, exercises, hydro demos, and so much more! 

We hope you enjoy! 

Best Wishes, 

Jess and The Team
Founder and Director Herts Horses Hydro and Physio
Msc Veterinary Physiotherapy 

www.hertshorseshydro.co.uk
